FICTIONAL UNIVERSITY — DISCIPLINARY AND SAFETY POLICY (synthetic test data) Quiet hours are 10 PM to 6 AM daily.
Smoking, alcohol consumption and unauthorized electrical cooking appliances are prohibited in hostel rooms.
For a first quiet-hours violation, the warden issues a written warning.
FICTIONAL UNIVERSITY — ROOM ALLOCATION POLICY (synthetic test data) Room allocation is managed by the hostel office.
First-year students are normally allocated triple-sharing rooms.
Returning students may request single or double-sharing rooms, subject to availability.
Approved accessibility accommodations take priority over ordinary room preferences.
Room change requests may be submitted after the first 14 calendar days of the semester.
A room change requires written approval from the warden.
Residents must not exchange rooms without approval.
This document describes allocation rules only.
Refundable security deposit: 5000, paid once on first admission.
Late payment attracts a flat 500 fee after the payment deadline of 15 July 2026.
For cancellation before move-in, 90% of the room fee is refunded.
Cancellation within 15 calendar days after move-in receives 50% of the room fee.
After that, no room fee refund is available.
Security deposit is refunded within 30 days of checkout, less documented damage charges.
Mess fee refund rules are not specified in this policy.

For a first quiet-hours violation, the warden issues a written warning.
A second quiet-hours violation attracts a 500 INR fine.
Further violations are referred to the disciplinary committee; no fixed additional fine is specified.
